# baekje rewrite notes (#72–#77)

Patch script: `scripts/.cache/rewrite/baekje.mjs` (idempotent, editStory only). `validate.mjs 72 77` → ok. Anchors: only the baseline `alchun-restraint` ("Alchun") is unmatched in range; the old broken anchors in range now match.

## #72 Yellow Mountain
- Opens on Gyebek, with the Red Fowl arriving inside the scene. A new adjutant, Seokdal, gets the reports and goes quiet in the fifth clash. Five-beat duel. Gwanchang mirror. Kangrim's origin fixed to the Yumla story, plus a resurrection beat paying off #71. A #4 flashback leads into "I gave my word". Prompt fragments and the spoiler formation note are cut.
- First: "Gyebek can count to fifty thousand. He has done it twice since dawn. The answer has not improved."
- Card: "The pass is open. The river is open. And in Sabi, a runner is climbing the palace steps with one word…!" (19 words)

## #73 Sabi
- Opens on the runner's word. Six of the seven quotes are cut (the Ye Sikjin epitaph stays). The cliff and maids are folded into one Falling Flowers naming. The feast is expanded. New Gumil scene paying off the Daeya grain clerk ("My daughter was in that fortress." / "Nobody is going to tell yours.").
- First: "The runner has one word. Euija makes him say it twice."
- Card (unchanged): "Across the sea, a confession is waiting for Euija. It is already written, in a lovely hand. It only needs his name…!" (22)

## #74 Buyeo Euija†
- Summaries and eulogy cut. Kangrim's binary kept ("Zengzi of the East… or dragon?" / "…The dragon. Obviously."). New climax: a river montage flashback that answers "the name, or me?" ("…You. It was you, you idiot.").
- First: "An empire is not finished with a king until he has signed something."
- Card (unchanged): "Baekje is gone. Goguryeo still stands. And the man who arranged both can no longer get out of bed…?" (19)

## #75 Kim Chunchu†
- Double opening cut, sister error fixed. New Yushin goodbye and Munhee skirt exchange. Kangrim's binary ("…Yes.") and "Heaven does not make house calls. I do." Accession quote and table cut.
- First: "Chunchu has talked his way out of every room in Samhan. This one has no other door."
- Card (unchanged): "Silla won the war. So why does the emperor’s new edict call its king a clerk…?" (16)

## #76 Ungjin Commandery
- Opens on the Chang'an renaming, with the Red Fowl's Silla answer moved here from #74. Liu Rengui gets a calendar through-line. New climax: Boksin's siege of Sabi, broken by the census. The edict is now two spoken lines. Four-dragons, the hangul table and the edict quote are cut.
- First: "In Chang’an, the cheapest way to conquer a country is to rename it."
- Card (unchanged): "Baekje has no king. Across the sea, an exiled prince is packing his bags…!" (14)

## #77 King Pungjang
- Opens on Pung on the crossing ("I used to know it"). Asuka becomes a flashback triggered by that lament. The sword is shown in the hall, not as a 371 flashback, and the forty-two-thousand spoiler is cut. Nihon Shoki edict, sutra quote, 643 spy flashback and repeats are cut. New wall scene ("Until I need you"). Pisong is played as a Pung/Echi argument.
- First: "Baekje is finished, says everyone except Baekje."
- Card: "Baekje has its king back, and a general who already regrets it. Now the emperor turns north, to walls that have never fallen…!" (22). Leads to #78 Pyongyang I.

- Seokdal and Kim Heumsun are speaker labels only, since the brief bans new people.
- Kept the #76 four-beasts diagram (#78's White Tiger needs it) and the Munmu coronation card in #75.
- Pung's Yamato wife thread is not added.
- Kangrim's question to Gyebek stays the protected family question; the #29 "Judge it yourself" plant is unused.
- No live Euija–Gyebek reunion after #66 (that falls in #67–#70). Euija's grief is in #73 and his "the name or me" answer is in #74.
